description: This file defines data structures and JSON unmarshalling methods for handling OTLP trace data in the OpenTelemetry SDK, including Traces, ResourceSpans, ScopeSpans, and related components.

classes.name: Traces
classes.description: Represents a collection of resource spans for tracing data.

classes.name: ResourceSpans
classes.description: Represents spans associated with a specific resource.

classes.name: ScopeSpans
classes.description: Represents spans produced by an instrumentation scope.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Custom JSON unmarshalling for Traces, ResourceSpans, and ScopeSpans to decode OTLP JSON format.
